title: export_request
description: Request body for POST /v1/audit/export (F002 T061 / FR-022). Parsed by Recurse.Gateway.AuditPlane.ExportHandler.parse_run_ids/1. Per MR !51 the SPA wire shape is {run_ids: [<run_id>, ...]} (max 100). Single-run-id export is the SPA's Receipt Detail 'Download Export Evidence' CTA; multi-run-id is the SPA's BulkActionBar follow-up flow (post F3 retire). Response is synchronous Content-Type: application/zip; see export_response.json.

run_ids.description: Non-empty list of run_ids to bundle. Backend caps at 100 per call; over-cap returns 400 ERR_BAD_REQUEST.

items.description: Receipt run_id; backend looks each up via Repo.get(Attestation, run_id).
